## Task 4 – The menu

**In your workspace**, in Task 4 of `index.qmd`, from the chunk `try-baseline` to the chunk `submit-exploration`. Try the reproduced specification and three or four others, changing one argument at a time. Then rerun the one that you would defend and send it with `submit_exploration()`. Your dot is drawn on the class chart as an exploratory result.

[Open the deck at Task 4](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-4-work-the-menu){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-explore){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## Your placement

Rerun the specification that you submitted with `try_spec()`, in the console of your IDE or in the chunk `try-one-at-a-time`, read off your own placement among the 864 specifications of the curve, and send it in the chat when the facilitator says go. Without a submission of your own, use the placement of the reproduced specification, which is 67%.

[Open the deck at your placement](../../live/day.html#/find-your-own-percentile){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

## Task 5 – The preregistration

**In the preregistration block of your report**, the chunk `prereg` of `index.qmd`. Complete the block before you run anything, run it, render the report, and type "declared" in the chat. When the class has declared, go on to the chunks `build-model`, `run-spec` and `report`, and send your result with `report_result()`. Your result is drawn on the chart as a declared one beside the exploratory round.

[Open the deck at Task 5](../../live/day.html#/the-preregistration-moment){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 5](../../lab.qmd#task-5-my-preregistration){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
